g.text: Observed (overview): capture, then independent check, in one replayed launching-capture test
Participants are documentation components (component-view.md): capture: Capture and replay entry
points; run writer: Run writer; framing: Framing and native records; compatibility:
Compatibility selection; mapping: Source mappers; persistence: Core persistence; reader: Package
reader; oracle: Independent oracle; profiles: Source profiles. Arrows from the left edge are the
test's own calls (not recorded). Calls into the shared JSON and byte code are drawn on their
One replayed test: a stand-in script replays a labelled synthetic Codex exec stream through
CliCapture; not a live run. Calls inside a component are folded, except a thread's own steps.
par: the two branches ran at once on two threads (the polls and the reader's run() are calls on
one Pump object; the polls returned false until the reader ended). Position orders calls within
a branch only. Full trace: observed-launch-sequence.svg.
